title.narrative: Support to Farmers Organisations for ACP

description.narrative: Farmers¿ Organizations for ACP is a capacity building programme aiming to increase income and to improve livelihood, food and nutrition security and safety of the ACP family farming in the target areas of the project, through greater integration of family farms in key agricultural value chains. The action proposed is in line with the Consensus, which clearly specifies that support to smallholders, including family farmers and pastoralists, remains of central importance, contributing substantially to food security and to the fight against soil erosion and biodiversity loss, while providing jobs. The EU and its member States will promote the creation of farmers' organisations and cooperatives to address, among other things, better productivity of family farms, land use rights and traditional farmer-based seed systems. The Action will support Farmers' Organizations in ACP countries to improve the livelihoods and food security situation of smallholder farmers and ensure sustainable and inclusive growth by strengthening FOs institutional and organisational capacities and improving FOs entrepreneurial capacities and participation in value chains. The main stakeholders will be Panafrican Farmers' Organisation (PAFO), Regional, National and Subnational Farmers' Organisations, as well as AgriCord and its network of agri-agencies. Farmers' organizations in the Caribbean and Pacific regions will be identified during the inception phase of this programme. This is a follow-up/scaling-up to the Support to Farmers Organisations in Africa programme - main phase - SFOAP (CRIS 308-200)
